commands.command:
set -eu
ROOT="$HOME/agent-workspace/repos/photomap/work"
WT="$HOME/agent-workspace/repos/photomap/worktrees/unified-ux-baseline-20261104"
git -C "$ROOT" fetch origin main
if [ ! -f "$WT/.git" ] && [ ! -d "$WT/.git" ]; then
  git -C "$ROOT" worktree add --detach "$WT" origin/main
fi
test -z "$(git -C "$WT" status --porcelain)"
if [ ! -e "$WT/frontend/node_modules" ]; then
  ln -s "$ROOT/frontend/node_modules" "$WT/frontend/node_modules"
fi
export PYTHON="$ROOT/backend/.venv/bin/python"
export E2E_CHROME_EXECUTABLE="/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome"
cd "$WT/frontend"
echo "BASELINE_SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
npm run test:e2e -- e2e/visual/map.spec.ts --grep 'visual: empty desktop map|visual: map markers, gallery and photo detail|place marker hit area|pinned media card exposes|pinned media portrait cards' --workers=1 --reporter=list
